name: @loom/provenance-explain
description: loom-ui U12 on an incident-triage board: the reference planner composes it and its decision is stamped on the ops, a card is hand-edited and reverted, Lineage.explain answers 'why is this here' differently for a cleared on-call viewer and a low-clearance one, what each viewer was shown is recorded in a per-viewer SeenLog (refs sealed under a per-viewer key) and replayed as of an approval, erasing a viewer is crypto-shredding, and the mark-and-sweep collector reclaims that viewer's unique blobs while shared and lineage blobs survive. Headless.
